name: 3D Texture Proxy Geometry
aliases: 3D Texture Volume Rendering via Parallel Slices
definition: A technique using view-aligned slices and 3D textures for volume rendering, leveraging hardware-accelerated tri-linear interpolation to resample the volume at arbitrary locations.
summary: 3D Texture Proxy Geometry is a GPU-accelerated volume rendering technique that rasterizes polygonal slices against a 3D texture, differing from ray casting by using hardware texture sampling instead of explicit ray marching.
